Message:
serial: add ADDI-DATA GmbH PCI-Express communication cards in 8250_pci.c and pci_ids.h

Add support for ADDI-DATA GmbH PCI-Express communication cards:

APCIe-7300
APCIe-7420
APCIe-7500
APCIe-7800

Warning: 8250_pci.c depends on pci_ids.h. 8250_pci.c
